findings.summary: The page says `docker volume prune` deletes every unused volume with no warning, which is wrong on both counts.
findings.evidence: "`docker volume prune` deletes every unused volume, no warning"
findings.fix: Write: "`docker volume prune` asks for confirmation (skipped with -f). Since Docker Engine 23 it removes only unused anonymous volumes. Unused named volumes are removed only with `--all`/`-a`." Keep the warning to back up before pruning.

findings.summary: The Compose page relies on healthchecks, which are not introduced until the production page.

findings.summary: Linux capabilities and setuid are used as hardening controls without being defined.
findings.evidence: "`--cap-drop ALL`, add back only needed; `no-new-privileges` blocks setuid"
findings.fix: Add a half-line gloss: capabilities are split-up root privileges (such as binding low ports), and setuid lets a binary run as its owner.

findings.summary: The page 11 title is shorter than the matching topic in the caption's list, so the two don't match.
findings.evidence: Title: "Debugging Containers"; caption topic: "Debugging and Troubleshooting Containers"
findings.fix: Rename the page title to "Debugging and Troubleshooting Containers", or shorten the caption topic to "Debugging Containers".

findings.summary: The page presents `--memory` as protection against an OOM kill, but it is the limit that causes a container OOM kill. What the limit does is stop a leak from hurting the host.
findings.evidence: Table row ["--memory","OOM kill"] under "Guards against"; bullet "No `--memory`: one leak means **OOM** kill"
findings.fix: Write: "--memory → caps one container so a leak OOM-kills only that container (exit 137) instead of starving the host". Change the bullet to "No `--memory`: a leak can exhaust host RAM and trigger the host OOM killer on other processes".

findings.summary: The Swarm vs Kubernetes table uses 'CRDs' with no explanation.

findings.summary: The `system prune --volumes` description omits that recent Docker versions remove only anonymous volumes unless `--all` is also given.
